title: A date range with nothing invoiced shows the no-results message
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 1 S1-N1 Reports Story 3 S3-R1)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick Custom range in the Date filter.
  3. Type a From and To date in a month next year (for example Jan 1 and Jan 31, 2027).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens on this month.

Step 2:

  • From and To boxes show under Custom range.

Step 3:

  • The table reads "There are no results for selected date range" under a calendar icon, with no Totals row.
  • The Date chip shows the picked range.
